sources.entry: ToTheTop - Small macOS application to help you scroll to the top.

summary.one_liner: ToTheTop is a small macOS app that brings iOS-style tap-the-status-bar-to-scroll-to-top behavior to the front-most application.
summary.what_it_does: The app creates an invisible clickable area in the macOS status bar at the top center of the screen, sized 60x22 pixels according to the README. When that area is clicked, it generates a home key keystroke using CGEvent. The keystroke causes the front-most application to scroll to the top. The README describes no other features or settings.
use_cases: scroll to top of a page on macOS
iOS-style status bar scroll gesture on a Mac
jump to top of long document without keyboard
quick scroll-to-top in any macOS app
stack: Swift or Objective-C (not named in README)
notable: Invisible click target in the top-center status bar, mimicking iOS scroll-to-top
Sends a home key event via CGEvent to the front-most app
caveats: Fixed 60x22 pixel click area; the README gives no option to change it
README does not describe installation steps or releases
